title: Velvety Vietnamese Chicken Pho Ga
description: A winey and pillowy Vietnamese dish featuring makrut lime leaves, perfect for a date night, made with sous-vide cooking and without onion or garlic.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, soy sauce, and brown sugar to make the marinade.
Add the chicken breast to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the sous-vide machine to 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and seal it in a sous-vide bag with 2 makrut lime leaves.
Cook the chicken in the sous-vide machine for 2 hours.
While the chicken is cooking, cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large wok, combine the chicken broth, 2 makrut lime leaves, and cooked noodles, and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Slice the cooked chicken into thin strips and add it to the wok.
Stir in the bean sprouts and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the pho ga hot, garnished with basil leaves, lime wedges, and remaining makrut lime leaves.
